//: Some tutorial steps deliberately leave an argument socket empty for the student
Those snippets cannot compile, so md-to-ts.py substitutes a value HERE, in the
generated test only. The markdown keeps its blank and still poses the question.
Each value is the answer the tutorial itself shows in a later step -- not an
invented one. Keyed by tutorial file, then by the callee whose arguments are
missing; the value is the full argument list.
A blank with no entry here fails the build, which is the intended behaviour:
someone has to decide what the answer is rather than have it guessed.
